		double diff1 = fabs((double)a1 / b - (double)x / y);
		double diff2 = fabs((double)a2 / b - (double)x / y);

			aout = a1; bout = b;
		}
		if (diff2 < mn - EPS) {
			mn = diff2;
			aout = a2; bout = b;
		}
		++b;
	}
	printf("%lld/%lld", aout, bout);

	Fraction best = {0, 1, 1e18};
	double target = (double)x / y;
	for (long long b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {

		if (diff2 < best.diff - EPS) {

		}

	printf("%lld/%lld", best.num, best.den);
